compile.globalConstraints:
- The synced shape is untouched: `client/src/Store.tsx` — the one `MergeableStore`, its `WsSynchronizer` and its SQLite persister — is byte-identical to BASE, and so are `client/src/storeData.ts` and `client/src/todoTags.ts`: the `tags` cell, `setTodoTags` and `normalizeTags` are consumed, never edited.
- The box is the design system's own `Input` from `@/components/ui/input`, carrying its `data-slot="input"`: no raw colour, no arbitrary value, no inline style, no class that is not a Tailwind class, and no restyling beyond layout (`w-40 shrink-0` is layout; a colour or a radius is not).
- Every control an exam reaches is reached by role and accessible name — the box's name is `Tags for <todo text>` through `aria-label`, so two rows are two names — and every view selects by id or by `data-*`, never by a class.
- The exam is hermetic and proves only itself: it spawns no test runner, opens no network, reads its fixtures inside test bodies, and every pinned literal in it is one the plan pins.
